additional_info.subject: ID0426917-DC/Si-D/DK-[MP/S3 170003354] Wrong Temperature on PT1 CRM:02889000032
additional_info.body:
Hi Rasmus, please follow the next steps. We already aligned on what to do next but I need to document what should be the next activity.
Here are the next troubleshooting steps:
Measure the temperature sensor and check if there is 1kOhm (remember to remove the cables from the connectors in order to avoid a bad reading).
If yes, then measure on the StateMonitor
If it has 1kOhm, try replacing the grey connector.
If it still doesn't work, even though we have 1kOhm at the input, please replace the StateMonitor.
If it doesn't have 1kOhm, then we need to check backwards, where we lose the 1kOhm, maybe in the XD12, measure before and after this connector.
If no, then the cable sensor is faulty and needs to be replaced the whole CCS
Another thing we can check is if there was any water leakage, can you please shake the plug and see if you can feel water inside? I had a similar issue in a different country where the symptoms are the same, so it could be this too.
I will send this ticket to your queue. Please reach out to me with 1 day in advance if you need site support to prepare.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco
